asset.name: Skill Tree Unlock UI System
asset.description:
Add a clean and configurable skill tree unlock UI to your game. Players can unlock skills, spend in-game currency, view tooltips, and progress through different upgrade paths.
The system includes configurable skill trees, upgrade nodes, prices, descriptions, icons, colors, requirements, and layout positions. You can create simple or branching upgrade paths through the included configuration module.
Includes animated UI, tooltip popups, draggable skill tree canvas, currency display, unlock states, and saving support. Skill effects can be applied through player attributes so your own game scripts can read and use them easily.
Designed for simulator, tycoon, idle, clicker, RPG, pet, combat, or progression-based games.
Easy to set up, modular, and fully configurable through included setup files.
